units.slavonic_incipit: Не ктомꙋ̀ ᲂу҆же́ пла́менное ѡ҆рꙋ́жїе, храни́тъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: не ктому уже пламенное оружие хранит врат едемских
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Не ктомꙋ̀ ᲂу҆же́ пла́менное ѡ҆рꙋ́жїе, храни́тъ вра́тъ є҆де́мскихъ, на ты́я бо на́йде пресла́вный соꙋ́зъ, дре́во Крⷭ҇тное сме́ртное жа́ло, и҆ а҆́дова побѣ́да повѣде́ся. Прише́лъ бо є҆сѝ Сп҃се мо́й, вопїѧ̀ сꙋ́щымъ въ а҆́дѣ: Вни́дѣте па́ки въ ра́й :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* No longer does the flaming sword guard the gate of Eden, for upon it came a glorious bond: the Wood of the Cross; the sting of death and the victory of Hades have been driven back; for Thou didst come, O My Savior, crying unto those in Hades: "Enter ye again into Paradise!"

units.slavonic_incipit: Три кресты̀ водрꙋзѝ на Голгѡ́ѳѣ Пїла́тъ,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: три кресты водрузи на голгофе пилат два разбойником
units.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ. Три кресты̀ водрꙋзѝ на Голгѡ́ѳѣ Пїла́тъ, два разбо́йникѡмъ, и҆ є҆ди́нъ Жизнода́вцꙋ, є҆го́же ви́дѣ а҆́дъ, и҆ речѐ сꙋ́щымъ до́лѣ: Ѽ слꙋги моѧ̀, и҆ си́ло моѧ̀, кто́ въдрꙋзѝ гвозді́е въ се́рдце моѐ: Древѧ́ное мя ко́пїе внеза́пꙋ прободѐ, и҆ растерза́юся, и҆ внꙋ́трными болю̀, и҆ ᲂу҆тро́бою ᲂу҆язвля́юся, чꙋ́вства моѧ̀ снѣда́етъ дꙋ́хъ мо́й, и҆ понꙋжда́юся и҆зблева́ти А҆да́ма, и҆ сꙋ́щыя съ А҆да́момъ, дре́вомъ да́нныя ми, дре́во бо си́хъ вво́дитъ па́ки въ ра́й :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* Three crosses did Pilate plant on Golgotha: two for the thieves, and one for the Giver of life, Whom Hades beheld and said to those below: "O my servants and my power! Who has driven nails into my heart? A wooden spear has suddenly pierced me, and I am torn asunder; I am in pain in my inward parts, and my belly is wounded; my senses consume my spirit, and I am constrained to vomit forth Adam and those with Adam, who were given to me by a tree; for a Tree leads them again into Paradise!"[^1599]

units.slavonic_incipit: Пое́мъ, сла́вимъ, покланя́емся, и҆ велича́емъ твою̀
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ем славим покланяемся и величаем твою гди державу
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Пое́мъ, сла́вимъ, покланя́емся, и҆ велича́емъ твою̀ Гдⷭ҇и держа́вꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ пода́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ рабѡ́мъ твои́мъ Крⷭ҇тъ Бж҃твенный наслажде́нїе неѡскꙋдѣва́ющее, и҆ храни́теля дꙋ́шъ, и҆ тѣле́съ на́шихъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* We hymn, we glorify, we bow down, and we magnify Thy dominion, O Lord, for Thou hast given unto us Thy servants the divine Cross as an unfailing delight, and as the guardian of our souls and bodies.

units.slavonic_incipit: Не покажи́ мя Гдⷭ҇и въ де́нь
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: не покажи мя гди в ден испытания злыми
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Не покажи́ мя Гдⷭ҇и въ де́нь и҆спыта́нїя злы́ми ᲂу҆ничиже́нна, не ѡ҆тве́рзи ѿ лица̀ твое́гѡ посрамле́нна, но ᲂу҆ще́дри и҆ сп҃си́ мя твои́мъ чⷭ҇тны́мъ Крⷭ҇то́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ пребл҃гїй :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Show me not, O Lord, in the day of trial humiliated by evils; cast me not away from Thy presence in shame; but show compassion and save me by Thy precious Cross, as Thou art all-good!

units.slavonic_incipit: Проѡбразѝ бл҃гть тво́й Крⷭ҇те, ᲂу҆слажда́я Мѡѷсе́й
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: прообрази блгт твой крте услаждая мо сей воды горчайшыя
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Проѡбразѝ бл҃гть тво́й Крⷭ҇те, ᲂу҆слажда́я Мѡѷсе́й во́ды горча́йшыя дре́вомъ, и҆́бо го́рести стрⷭ҇тїй и҆зба́вихомся твое́ю Си́лою. тѣ́мже мы̀ ᲂу҆слади́ цѣлꙋ́ющыя тя ны́нѣ, въ ᲂу҆миле́нїи дꙋше́вномъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Moses prefigured thy grace, O Cross, sweetening the bitter waters with a tree;[^1601] for we have been delivered from the bitterness of the passions by thy power. Therefore sweeten us who kiss thee now in contrition of soul!

units.slavonic_incipit: Оу҆ма̀ мое́гѡ тѣснотꙋ̀, твое́ю мл҃твою разширѝ,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: оума моего тесноту твоею млтвою разшири влчце сътеснившая
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆ма̀ мое́гѡ тѣснотꙋ̀, твое́ю мл҃твою разширѝ, Влⷣчце, сътѣ́снившаѧ вся̀ навѣ́ты борца̀, и҆ пꙋте́мъ мя тѣ́снымъ наста́ви, къ програ́нїю житїѧ̀ и҆тѝ, Мт҃и Бж҃їя :~

units.slavonic_incipit: Пѣ́снь, и҆́. И҆рмо́съ. Се́дмъ седми́цею: Дре́вомъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: песн и ирмос седм седмицею древом иногда извлече
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, и҆́. И҆рмо́съ. Се́дмъ седми́цею: Дре́вомъ и҆ногда̀ и҆звлечѐ ѿ рѣкѝ секи́рꙋ, Бж҃ественный Є҆лїсе́й, пренаписа́въ тя и҆здале́ча, Крⷭ҇те всечⷭ҇тный, ѿ глꙋбины́ бо ле́сти тобо́ю къ вѣ́рѣ возведо́хомся и҆звѣ́стной, дне́шнїй де́нь ᲂу҆досто́ихомся ви́дѣти, и҆ вѣ́рою покланя́тися тебѣ̀, ѡ҆бъемлюще сп҃се́нїе :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos: "Sevenfold" (Се́дмъ седми́цею):*[^1603] *Troparion:* With a piece of wood of old the divine Elisha drew forth the axe-head from the river,[^1604] prefiguring thee from afar, O all-precious Cross; for from the depth of deception we have been brought up by thee unto sure faith, and we have been vouchsafed to see this present day, and to bow down before thee in faith, embracing salvation!

units.slavonic_incipit: Подзна́менова и҆здале́ча тебѐ Крⷭ҇те всечⷭ҇тный, въ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: дзнаменова издалеча тебе крте всечтный в блвениих иаков
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Подзна́менова и҆здале́ча тебѐ Крⷭ҇те всечⷭ҇тный, въ бл҃венїихъ І҆а́кѡвъ явле́ннѣе: мы́ же въ бл҃гти ᲂу҆досто́ившеся ви́дѣти тя, вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною пристꙋпа́емъ вси, и҆ кла́няющеся богатое бл҃венїе ѡ҆б- ѡ҆бъе́млемъ и҆ свѣ́тъ, и҆ сп҃се́нїе и҆ грѣхѡ́въ разрѣше́нїе :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Jacob prefigured thee from afar most clearly in his blessings, O all-precious Cross; and having been vouchsafed in grace to behold thee, we all approach with unhesitating faith, and bowing down, we embrace rich blessing, light, salvation, and the remission of sins![^1605]

units.slavonic_incipit: Кꙋпноще́ственна, събезнача́льна, съприсносꙋ́щна, съпрⷭ҇тна, є҆ство̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: купнощественна събезначальна съприсносущна съпртна ество убо простое разделительное
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Кꙋпноще́ственна, събезнача́льна, съприсносꙋ́щна, съпрⷭ҇тна, є҆ство̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ просто́е, раздѣли́тельное же ли́цы, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ нерожде́нна, Сн҃а и҆ Дх҃а ст҃гѡ, несозда́нное сꙋ́щество̀ и҆ Бж҃тво̀ вси воспѣва́юще пое́мъ, сщ҃енницы бл҃гвите, лю́дїе превъзноси́те є҆гѡ̀ въ вѣ́ки :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Trinity Troparion:* Consubstantial, co-unoriginate, co-eternal, co-enthroned, a simple essence yet distinct in Persons: the unbegotten Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit—all of us, hymning this uncreated essence and Godhead, sing: Ye priests, bless; ye people, highly exalt Him unto all ages!

units.slavonic_incipit: Ны́нѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнца незло́биваго зрѧ́щи ви́сяща,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ныне ко агнца незлобиваго зрящи висяща и от
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ны́нѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнца незло́биваго зрѧ́щи ви́сяща, и҆ ѿ беззако́нныхъ къ крⷭ҇тꙋ пригвожда́ема, Сн҃е мо́й пребезнача́лне, рыда́ньми снѣда́юся, и҆ мт҃рними ѡ҆держи́ма є҆́смь болѣ́зньми, всечⷭ҇тая вопїя́ше, ю҆́же гла́сы немо́лчными воспѣва́емъ по до́лгꙋ въ вся̑ вѣ́ки :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* *Theotokion:* "Beholding Thee now hanging like a gentle Lamb, nailed to the Cross by the lawless, O My Son Who art before all eternity, I am consumed with weeping and seized by maternal pangs!" cried the all-pure one, whom with unceasing voices we dutifully hymn unto all ages!

units.slavonic_incipit: Стрⷭ҇ть тебѐ безстра́стнаго зрѧ́щи тва́рь, състрада́ше
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: стрт тебе безстрастнаго зрящи твар състрадаше ти долготерпеливе
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Стрⷭ҇ть тебѐ безстра́стнаго зрѧ́щи тва́рь, състрада́ше ти долготерпѣли́ве, сл҃нце ᲂу҆гаса́шеся, ка́менїе распада́шеся, вся̀ земля̀ тряса́шеся, стра́хомъ зовꙋ́ще: Гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превъзноси́те є҆гѡ̀ въ вѣ́ки :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Beholding the Passion of Thee, the Passionless One, creation suffered with Thee, O Long-suffering One: the sun was darkened, the rocks were rent, and all the earth quaked, calling out in fear: "Praise the Lord, ye works, and highly exalt Him unto all ages!"[^1607]

units.slavonic_incipit: Звѣ́ремъ лю́тымъ стра́стнымъ, Бж҃е мо́й ще́дрый
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: зверем лютым страстным бже мой щедрый запрети внутр
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Звѣ́ремъ лю́тымъ стра́стнымъ, Бж҃е мо́й ще́дрый запретѝ, внꙋ́трь мя̀ ѡ҆скорбля́ющымъ, сп҃се безче́стное досажде́нїе претерпѣ́вый, бїе́мъ тро́стїю Хрїстѐ, почѐсти хотя̀ вся̀ безче́ствованныя, преступле́нїемъ дре́внимъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Rebuke the fierce beasts of passion that afflict me inwardly, O my compassionate God, O Savior Who didst endure dishonorable mockery, struck with a reed, O Christ, desiring to honor all those who had been dishonored by the ancient transgression!

units.slavonic_incipit: Въ ᲂу҆́мъ є҆гда̀ прїе́млю стра́шности сꙋди́ще,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в ум егда приемлю страшности судище судие судие
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ ᲂу҆́мъ є҆гда̀ прїе́млю стра́шности сꙋди́ще, сꙋдїѐ сꙋдїѐ првⷣнѣ́йшїй трепе́щꙋ, и҆ ᲂу҆жаса́юся стра́шїѧ, и҆ рыда́ю, помышля́я дѣла̀ моѧ̀ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїя досто́йнаѧ. тѣ́мже мно́гое твоѐ млⷭ҇рдїе Сп҃се мл҃и, да не побѣди́тъ тебѐ мно́жество ꙁѡ́лъ мои́хъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* When I take to mind the fearful judgment seat, O most righteous Judge, I tremble and am appalled with terror, and I lament as I ponder my deeds worthy of condemnation. Therefore let Thy great mercy, O Savior, be entreatable, lest the multitude of my evils overcome Thee!

units.slavonic_incipit: Ро́ждшаѧ тя безъ болѣ́знїй, болѣ́знемъ въ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: рождшая тя без болезний болезнем в твоем распятии
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ро́ждшаѧ тя безъ болѣ́знїй, болѣ́знемъ въ твое́мъ распѧ́тїи подлежꙋ̀, ѡ҆паля́етъся ᲂу҆тро́ба моѧ̀, гвоздьми́ бо пригвозди́лся є҆сѝ, ко́пїемъ въ ре́бра пробода́емъ долготерпѣли́ве, Прⷭ҇таѧ вопїя́ше Дв҃а, ю҆́же ꙗ҆́кѡ Бцⷣꙋ согла́снѡ воспѣва́емъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* *Theotokion:* "Having given birth to Thee without travail, I am subjected to pangs at Thy crucifixion; my womb is burned within me, for Thou hast been nailed with nails and pierced in the side with a spear, O Long-suffering One!" cried the All-pure Virgin, whom with one accord we hymn as the Theotokos.

units.slavonic_incipit: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Оу҆диви́ся ᲂу҆́бѡ: И҆сцѣли́лъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: песн ф ирмос оудивися убо исцелил еси преблгий
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Оу҆диви́ся ᲂу҆́бѡ: И҆сцѣли́лъ є҆сѝ пребл҃гїй моѐ сокрꙋше́нїе, на крⷭ҇тѣ пригвожда́емъ гвоздьмѝ и҆ногда̀, рꙋка́ма твои́ма и҆ нога́ма вкꙋ́пѣ, и҆ въ ре́бра пробода́емъ, ѡ҆́цтомъ напая́емъ и҆ же́лчїю, всѣ́хъ весе́лїе, сла́дости, сла́во, вѣ́чное и҆збавле́нїе :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. units.slavonic_incipit: Кра́сенъ па́че сапфі́ра и҆ зла́та, сїѧ́я
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: красен паче сапфира и злата сияя коже слнце
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Кра́сенъ па́че сапфі́ра и҆ зла́та, сїѧ́я ꙗ҆́кѡже сл҃нце бы́лъ є҆сѝ Бж҃твенный крⷭ҇те, лежа́ ᲂу҆́бѡ мѣ́стомъ ѡ҆пи́санъ, и҆ ᲂу҆́мными Си́лами всю́дꙋ ѡ҆прꙋжа́емъ стра́шнѡ, лꙋча́ми же Бж҃ественными твоеѧ̀ си́лы просвѣща́ѧй вселе́нныя и҆сполне́нїа :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Fairer than sapphire and gold, shining like the sun hast thou proved, O divine Cross: while lying circumscribed by place and surrounded with awe on every side by the noetic Powers, yet by the divine rays of thy power thou dost enlighten the fullness of the universe!

units.slavonic_incipit: Крⷭ҇тъ ѡ҆бꙋрева́емымъ є҆́стъ приста́нище, наста́вникъ блꙋдѧ́щымъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: крт обуреваемым ест пристанище наставник блудящым и утверждение
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Крⷭ҇тъ ѡ҆бꙋрева́емымъ є҆́стъ приста́нище, наста́вникъ блꙋдѧ́щымъ и҆ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе, сла́ва Хв҃а, си́ла А҆пⷭ҇лѡвъ и҆ Прⷪ҇рѡ́кѡвъ, По́стникѡвъ держа́ва, всѣ́хъ чл҃къ прибѣ́жище, тогѡ̀ посредѣ̀ прележа́ща вси зрѧ́ще воздержа́нїемъ лобыза́имъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The Cross is a haven for the tempest-tossed, a guide and confirmation for the wandering, the glory of Christ, the strength of Apostles and Prophets, the power of Fasting Ascetics, the refuge of all men: beholding it lying in the midst, let all of us embrace it through abstinence!

units.slavonic_incipit: Є҆гда̀ и҆́маши прїитѝ на́ землю сꙋди́ти
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: егда имаши приити на землю судити мир егоже
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Є҆гда̀ и҆́маши прїитѝ на́ землю сꙋди́ти мі́ръ, є҆го́же созда́лъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и, А҆́гглкимъ пред̾идꙋ́щымъ твои́мъ во́инствамъ, крⷭ҇тꙋ проїѧвля́ющꙋся па́че за́рей сл҃нечныхъ, тогѡ̀ могꙋ́тствомъ ᲂу҆ще́дри мя̀, сп҃сѝ па́че всѣ́хъ чл҃къ па́дшаго :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* When Thou shalt come upon earth to judge the world which Thou hast created, O Lord,[^1611] with Thine angelic hosts preceding Thee, and the Cross shining forth brighter than the rays of the sun, by its might show compassion upon me and save me, who have fallen beyond all men!

units.slavonic_incipit: Тлѣ́нїя тя кро́мѣ роди́хъ и҆зъ ᲂу҆тро́бы,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тления тя кроме родих из утробы прежде век
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Тлѣ́нїя тя кро́мѣ роди́хъ и҆зъ ᲂу҆тро́бы, пре́жде вѣ́къ є҆го́же Ѻ҆ц҃ъ родѝ, и҆ ка́кѡ тлѣ́еши; чл҃вцы терза́ютъ тя, Сн҃е, и҆ ре́бра и҆скопова́ютъ ко́пїемъ, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ съ нога́ма пригвожда́ютъ безчеловѣ́чнѡ, всечⷭ҇тая взыва́ше, ю҆́же досто́йнѡ велича́емъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* *Theotokion:* "Without corruption I gave birth from my womb unto Thee, Whom the Father begat before the ages, and how art Thou subject unto corruption? Men tear Thee asunder, O Son, dig into Thy ribs with a spear, and nail Thy hands and feet inhumanly!" cried the all-pure one, whom worthily we magnify.

units.slavonic_incipit: Хе̄, рꙋ́цѣ же распросте́ръ, рꙋ́ки и҆зба́вилъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: хе руце же распростер руки избавил еси борца
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Хе̄, рꙋ́цѣ же распросте́ръ, рꙋ́ки и҆зба́вилъ є҆сѝ бѡрца̀, недержа́нно просте́ршагѡ рꙋ́цѣ къ снѣ́ди пло́да, є҆го́же сама́го въкꙋше́нїѧ, бѣ́жати ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ, Хрⷭ҇те многомл҃тиве :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Grant us with pure hearts to behold Thy Passion, O Christ, which pours forth dispassion unto all men, as in dispassion we bow down before Thy precious Cross, overlooking our sins, and making us true sons of the Resurrection!

units.slavonic_incipit: Стрⷭ҇ть твои́ Хе̄ всѣ̑мъ чл҃кѡмъ, безстра́стїе
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: стрт твои хе всем члком безстрастие источающу чисто
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Стрⷭ҇ть твои́ Хе̄ всѣ̑мъ чл҃кѡмъ, безстра́стїе и҆сточа́ющꙋ чи́стѡ ви́дѣти сподо́би, въ безстра́стїи покланя́ющїимся твое́мꙋ крⷭ҇тꙋ чⷭ҇тно́мꙋ, грѣхи̑ на́шѧ презира́яй, и҆ воскрⷭ҇нїя и҆́стиннагѡ сн҃ы сотворя́ѧ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou Who hast raised us up that were fallen into death, and by Thy Resurrection hast destroyed death, and brought us unto Thy Father, pouring out Thy blood for our sake, O Benefactor: therefore we glorify Thee, as our all-powerful God and Deliverer!

units.slavonic_incipit: Вознесы́й на́съ па́дшихъ въ сме́рть, и҆
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: вознесый нас падших в смерт и въскрнием твоим
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Вознесы́й на́съ па́дшихъ въ сме́рть, и҆ въскрⷭ҇нїемъ твои́мъ, раздра́бшивый [раздрꙋ́шивый] сме́рть, и҆ Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ свое́мꙋ на́съ приведы́й, на́съ ра́ди кро́вь свою̀ и҆злїя́вый бл҃гтлю [бл҃годѣ́телю]. Тѣ́мже тя сла́вимъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃а и҆зба́вителя всеси́лна :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* *Theotokion:* O thou who alone didst give birth to the hypostatic Wisdom of God: make me wise by thy prayers to escape the counsels, snares, and wiles of the crafty one, O Bride unwedded, Virgin Theotokos, firm refuge of the faithful!

units.slavonic_incipit: И҆́стинны стяжа́телю, и҆ сокрове́нныхъ ви́дче Гдⷭ҇и,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: истинны стяжателю и сокровенных видче гди фарисеа тщеславием
units.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́стинны стяжа́телю, и҆ сокрове́нныхъ ви́дче Гдⷭ҇и, Фарисе́а тщесла́вїемъ побѣжда́ема, и҆ ѿ дѣ́лъ добродѣ́телми ѡ҆правда́ющася ѡ҆сꙋди́лъ є҆сѝ, Мытаря́ же съ ᲂу҆миле́нїемъ моля́щася, и҆ ѡ҆ ѻ҆́нагѡ ѡ҆сꙋжда́ема, ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ. є҆го́же покая́нїю и҆ на́съ ревни́теля покажѝ, распны́йсе на́съ ра́ди, и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїа сподо́би, ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ :~ В҃.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron:* O Lord, Possessor of truth and Beholder of secret things, Who didst condemn the Pharisee overcome by vainglory and justifying himself by deeds of virtue, and didst justify the Publican praying with contrition and condemned by him:[^1616] show us also to be emulators of his repentance, O Thou Who wast crucified for our sake, and vouchsafe unto us remission, as Thou art the Lover of mankind! *(Twice)*
units.slavonic_text: И҆́стинны стяжа́телю, и҆ сокрове́нныхъ ви́дче Гдⷭ҇и, Фарисе́а тщесла́вїемъ побѣжда́ема, и҆ ѿ дѣ́лъ добродѣ́телми ѡ҆правда́ющася ѡ҆сꙋди́лъ є҆сѝ, Мытаря́ же съ ᲂу҆миле́нїемъ моля́щася, и҆ ѡ҆ ѻ҆́нагѡ ѡ҆сꙋжда́ема, ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ. є҆го́же покая́нїю и҆ на́съ ревни́теля покажѝ, распны́йсе на́съ ра́ди, и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїа сподо́би, ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ :~ В҃.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: кто не дивится зря стыи мчнцы подвиг добрый
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Кто̀ не диви́тся зря̀ ст҃ы́и Мч҃нцы подвигъ до́брый, и҆́мже подвиза́стеся; ка́кѡ въ пло́ти сꙋ́ще, безпло́тнаго врага̀ побѣди́сте! Ха̀ и҆сповѣ́давше, крⷭ҇то́мъ въѡрꙋжи́вшеся. Тѣ́мже досто́йнѡ ꙗ҆ви́стеся, бѣ́сѡмъ прогони́телїе, и҆ ва́рварѡмъ бо́рцы, непреста́ннѡ мл҃ите сп҃ти́ся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron:* Who does not marvel, O holy Martyrs, beholding the good contest wherein ye struggled?[^1617] How, being in the flesh, ye conquered the bodiless foe, confessing Christ and arming yourselves with the Cross! Therefore worthily have ye been revealed as expellers of demons and champions against barbarians; unceasingly pray that our souls may be saved!

units.slavonic_incipit: Дне́сь Влⷣка тва́ри, и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь сла́вы,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: днес влка твари и гд славы на крте
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь Влⷣка тва́ри, и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь сла́вы, на Крⷭ҇тѣ пригвожда́ется, и҆ въ ре́бра пробода́ется, же́лчъ и҆ ѡ҆́цетъ въкꙋша́етъ сла́дость Цр҃ко́внаѧ. Вѣнце́мъ ѿ те́рнїа ѡ҆блага́ется, покрыва́яй нб҃са̀ ѡ҆́блакы, багряни́цею ѡ҆блачи́тся порꙋга́нїа, и҆ заꙋша́ется бре́нною рꙋко́ю, рꙋко́ю созда́вый чл҃ка. по плещи́ма бїе́нъ быва́етъ, ѡ҆дѣва́яй не́бо ѡ҆́блакы. заплева́нїа и҆ ра́ны прїе́млетъ, и҆ нарꙋга́нїа и҆ поноше́нїя. и҆ вся̑ терпи́тъ менѐ ра́ди ѡ҆сꙋжде́ннаго, и҆зба́витель мо́й и҆ Бг҃ъ, да сп҃се́тъ мі́ръ ѿ пре́лести, ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇рдъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Doxasticon:* Today the Master of creation and Lord of glory is nailed upon the Cross, and is pierced in the side;[^1618] the sweetness of the Church tastes gall and vinegar![^1619] He Who covers the heaven with clouds is crowned with thorns; He is robed in a purple garment of mockery; and He Who formed man with His hand is struck by a mortal hand! He Who robes the heaven with clouds is beaten upon His back; He receives spittings and wounds, mockery and reproaches; and all these things my Deliverer and God endures for the sake of me, the condemned, that He may save the world from deception, as He is tender-hearted!

units.slavonic_incipit: ТА́Кѡ гл҃етъ Гдⷭ҇ь: Приближа́ютъся мнѣ̀ лю́дїе
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тако глет гд приближаютъся мне людие сии устнами
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ТА́Кѡ гл҃етъ Гдⷭ҇ь: Приближа́ютъся мнѣ̀ лю́дїе сі́и ᲂу҆стна́ми свои́ми, и҆ ᲂу҆стна́ми свои́ми чтꙋ́тъ мя, срⷣце же и҆́хъ дале́че ѿстои́тъ ѿ менѐ, всꙋ́е же чтꙋ́тъ мя, ᲂу҆ча́щи за́повѣди чловѣ́ческїя и҆ ᲂу҆че́нїа. [v. 14] Сегѡ̀ ра́ди се́азъ приложꙋ̀ преложи́ти лю́ди сїя̑, и҆ преложꙋ̀ и҆́хъ, и҆ погꙋблю̀ премꙋ́дрость премꙋ́дрыхъ, и҆ ра́зꙋмъ разꙋ́мныхъ и҆́хъ сокры́ю. [v. 15] Го́ре глубо́кїй творя́щымъ совѣ́тъ, а҆ не за Гдⷭ҇а. въ та́йнѣ совѣ́тъ творя́щимъ, и҆ бꙋ́дꙋтъ въ тмѣ̀ дѣла̀ и҆́хъ. и҆ рекꙋ́тъ, кто́ насъ ви́дѣ; и҆ кто́ насъ разꙋмѣ́етъ; и҆лѝ я҆́же мы̀ твори́мъ; [v. 16] Не ꙗ҆́кѡ бре́нїе ли скꙋде́лника въмѣни́теся; є҆да̀ рече́тъ зда́нїе созда́вшому є҆̀, не ты́ мя созда́лъ є҆сѝ; и҆лѝ творенїе сътво́ршому, неразꙋ́мнѡ мя сътвори́лъ є҆сѝ; [v. 17] Не є҆ще́ ли ма́лѡ, и҆ преложи́тся Лива́нъ въ го́рꙋ Херме́лъ, и҆ Херме́лъ въ дꙋбра́вꙋ въмѣни́тся; [v. 18] И҆ ᲂу҆слы́шатъ въ де́нь ѻ҆́ный, глꙋсі́и словеса̀ кни́жнаѧ, и҆ и҆̀же въ тмѣ̀, и҆ и҆̀же въ мглѣ̀, ѻ҆́чи слѣпы́хъ ᲂу҆́зрятъ. [v. 19] И҆ възра́дꙋются ни́щїи за Гдⷭ҇а въ весе́лїи, и҆ ненаде́жнїи въ чл҃вцѣ́хъ, и҆спо́лнятся весе́лїа. [v. 20] И҆счезѐ беззако́нный, и҆ поги́бе го́рдый, и҆ потреби́шася беззако́ннꙋющїи въ зло́бѣ. [v. 21] И҆ творя́щїи согрѣша́ти чловѣ́кы, въ сло́вѣ, вся́ же ѡ҆блича́ющыя при вра́тѣхъ, претыка́нїе поло́жатъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ᲂу҆клони́ша въ непра́вдѣ првⷣнаго. [v. 22] Сегѡ̀ ра́ди та́кѡ гл҃етъ Гдⷭ҇ь, на до́мъ І҆а́кѡвовъ, є҆го́же ѿлꙋчѝ ѿ А҆враа́ма, не ны́нѣ ли постыди́тся І҆а́кѡвъ; не ны́нѣ ли и҆змѣни́тся лицѐ І҆и҃лево; [v. 23] Но є҆гда̀ ви́дятъ ча́да и҆́хъ дѣла̀ моѧ̑, мене́ ра́ди ѡ҆ст҃я́тъ и҆́мя моѐ, и҆ ѡ҆ст҃я́тъ ст҃го І҆а́кѡвла, и҆ Бг҃а І҆и҃лева ᲂу҆боя́тся :~
units.english_cohort_translation: Thus says the Lord: These people draw near unto Me with their mouth, and with their lips they honor Me, but their heart is far from Me; and in vain do they worship Me, teaching the commandments and doctrines of men. Therefore, behold, I will proceed to alter this people, and I will alter them; and I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will hide the understanding of their prudent ones. Woe unto them that seek deep counsel, and not through the Lord! They that take counsel in secret, and their works shall be in darkness; and they say: "Who has seen us? And who knows us, or what we do?" Shall ye not be esteemed as the clay of the potter? Shall the work say of Him that made it: "Thou madest me not"? Or shall the thing framed say of Him that framed it: "Thou hast made me without understanding"? Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into Mount Carmel, and Carmel shall be esteemed as a forest? And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and they that are in darkness, and they that are in mist, even the eyes of the blind shall see. And the poor shall rejoice because of the Lord in gladness, and the hopeless among men shall be filled with joy. For the lawless one has vanished, and the proud has perished, and they that commit iniquity in malice are cut off; and they that make men to sin in word, and lay a stumbling-block for all that reprove in the gates, having turned aside the righteous in unrighteousness. Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the house of Jacob, whom He separated from Abraham: Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall the face of Israel now change; but when their children see My works, for My sake they shall sanctify My Name, and shall sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

units.slavonic_incipit: РЕЧЀ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ къ А҆враа́мꙋ: И҆зы́йди
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: рече гд бг к аврааму изыйди от земля
units.slavonic_diplomatic: РЕЧЀ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ къ А҆враа́мꙋ: И҆зы́йди ѿ земля̀ твоея̀, и҆ ѿ сро́дства твое́гѡ, и҆ ѿ до́мꙋ ѻ҆тца̀ твое́гѡ, и҆ прїидѝ въ зе́млю ю҆́же а҆́ще ти покажꙋ̀. [v. 2] И҆ сътворю́ тя въ ꙗ҆зы́къ вели́кїй и҆ мно́гїй, и҆ бл҃гвлю́ тя, и҆ возвели́чꙋ и҆́мя твоѐ, и҆ бꙋ́деши бл҃венъ. [v. 3] И҆ бл҃гвлю̀ бл҃гвѧ́щїя тя, и҆ прокленꙋ̀ проклина́ющїя тя, и҆ бл҃гвѧ́тся ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ всѧ̑ колѣ́на земна̑я. [v. 4] И҆ и҆́де А҆вра́мъ, ꙗ҆́коже гла́ є҆мꙋ̀ Гдⷭ҇ь. и҆ и҆дя́ше с ни́мъ Лѡ́тъ. А҆вра́мꙋ же лѣ́тъ бѣ̀, се́мдесятъ пя́ть, є҆гда̀ и҆зы́йде ѿ Харра́на. [v. 5] И҆ прїя́тъ А҆вра́мъ Са́рꙋ женꙋ̀ свою̀, и҆ Лѡ́та сы́на бра́та своего̀, и҆ вся̑ и҆мѣ́нїя своя̑, є҆ли́ка стяжа́ша, и҆ вся́кꙋю дꙋ́шꙋ ю҆́же стяжа́ша въ Харра́нѣ, и҆ и҆зыдо́ша поитѝ въ зе́млю Ханаа́нескꙋю. и҆ внидо́ша въ зе́млю Ханаа́нскꙋю. [v. 6] И҆ пꙋтеше́ствова А҆вра́мъ зе́млю въ ширинꙋ̀ є҆ѧ̀, да́же до мѣ́ста Сихе́мъ, ᲂу҆ дꙋ́ба высо́каго.
units.english_cohort_translation: The Lord God said unto Abram: "Get thee out of thy land, and from thy kindred, and from the house of thy father, and come into the land that I will show thee. And I will make of thee a great and numerous nation, and I will bless thee, and magnify thy name, and thou shalt be blessed. And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse them that curse thee; and in thee shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed." And Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him. And Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran. And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot the son of his brother, and all their substance that they had acquired, and every soul which they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and they entered into the land of Canaan. And Abram passed through the land along its breadth, unto the place of Shechem, unto the lofty oak.

And Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him. And Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran. And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot the son of his brother, and all their substance that they had acquired, and every soul which they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and they entered into the land of Canaan. [v. 16] Премꙋ́дрый ᲂу҆боя́вся, ᲂу҆клони́тся ѿ зла̀, безꙋ́мный же себѣ̀ надѣ́явся, смѣша́ется съ беззако́ннымъ. [v. 17] Напра́сный дѣ́лаетъ съ безсовѣ́тїемъ, мꙋ́жъ же мꙋ́дрый мно́гая терпи́тъ. [v. 18] Раздѣля́тъ безꙋ́мнїи зло́бꙋ, кова́рныи же ᲂу҆держа́тъ чꙋ́вство. [v. 19] Попо́лзнꙋтся злі́и пре бл҃ги́ми, и҆ нечести́вїи послꙋ́жатъ пре две́рми првⷣныхъ. [v. 20] Дрꙋ́зи возненави́дятъ дрꙋ́гѡвъ ᲂу҆бо́гихъ, дрꙋ́зи же бога́тыхъ мно́зи. [v. 21] Ѡ҆безчеща́яй ни́щаго согрѣша́етъ, ми́лꙋяй же ᲂу҆бо́гїя бл҃же́нъ. [v. 22] Заблꙋжда́еми непра́ведницы дѣ́лаютъ зла̑я, млⷭ҇ть же и҆́стиннꙋ дѣ́лаютъ бл҃зі́и. [v. 23] Ненави́дятъ млⷭ҇ти и҆ вѣ́ры дѣ́лателїе злы́хъ. [v. 24] Млⷭ҇тыни же, и҆ вѣ́ры ᲂу҆ дѣ́телей бл҃ги́хъ. A wise man, having feared, turns away from evil; but the foolish, trusting in himself, mingles with the lawless. A hasty man acts without counsel, but a prudent man endures many things. The foolish shall distribute malice, but the prudent shall retain knowledge. The evil shall stumble before the good, and the ungodly shall wait at the gates of the righteous. Friends will hate poor friends, but the friends of the rich are many. He that dishonors the poor commits sin, but he that has mercy on the poor is blessed. The unrighteous, going astray, devise evil; but the good devise mercy and truth. The workers of evil understand neither mercy nor faith; but alms and faith are with the workers of good. In every one that is careful there is abundance; but the voluptuous and painless shall be in want. The crown of the wise is their riches, but the abode of fools is evil. A faithful witness will deliver a soul from evils, but a deceitful man kindles lies. In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence, and to His children He will leave a remnant of peace.

units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Ye passed beyond the bounds of the flesh, O Passion-bearers, by much endurance, having endured torments and afflictions; therefore do ye lighten every disease and affliction of those that praise you!

units.slavonic_incipit: Тмамъ А҆́гглъ, во́инство совокꙋпи́ся ст҃ы́хъ ст҃роте́рпецъ,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тмам аггл воинство совокупися стых стротерпец и млят

units.slavonic_incipit: Оу҆мертви́вся, и҆ въ гро́бѣ Хе̄ ᲂу҆снꙋ́въ,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: оумертвився и в гробе хе уснув возставил еси
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆мертви́вся, и҆ въ гро́бѣ Хе̄ ᲂу҆снꙋ́въ, возста́вилъ є҆сѝ ме́ртвыя, и҆ въ вѣ́рѣ ᲂу҆ме́ршимъ да́еши бл҃гти бога́тство Хе̄, поко́й съ всѣ́ми ст҃ы́ми :~

units.slavonic_incipit: Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ Сло́во, и҆́кїй ѡ҆живи́ти чл҃ка,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: бжие бг слово икий оживити члка чтая из
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ Сло́во, и҆́кїй ѡ҆живи́ти чл҃ка, чⷭ҇тая и҆зъ тебѐ воплоща́ется, и҆ зе́менъ ви́дится, є҆го́же непреста́ннѡ мл҃и, ѡ҆брѣстѝ на́мъ мл҃ть въ вре́мя ѿвѣ́та :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* *Theotokion:* God the Word of God, Who desires to bring man to life, is incarnate of thee, O pure one, and is seen as earthly; unceasingly pray Him that we may find mercy at the time of the answer!

units.slavonic_incipit: Мч҃нкъ торжество̀ ᲂу҆гля́дшимъ, просвѣти́мшеся дѣ́телми, и҆
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: мчнк торжество углядшим просветимшеся детелми и возопиим бгодукновенными
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Мч҃нкъ торжество̀ ᲂу҆гля́дшимъ, просвѣти́мшеся дѣ́телми, и҆ возопїи́мъ Бг҃одꙋкнове́нными пѣ́снми, вы̀ є҆стѐ вои́стиннꙋ денни́ца на землѝ, Хв҃и мч҃нци.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having beheld the triumph of the Martyrs, let us be enlightened by deeds, and let us cry out with divinely inspired hymns: "Ye are truly the dayspring upon earth, O Martyrs of Christ!"
units.slavonic_text: Мч҃нкъ торжество̀ ᲂу҆гля́дшимъ, просвѣти́мшеся дѣ́телми, и҆ возопїи́мъ Бг҃одꙋкнове́нными пѣ́снми, вы̀ є҆стѐ вои́стиннꙋ денни́ца на землѝ, Хв҃и мч҃нци.

units.slavonic_incipit: Пло́ти, и҆ кро́ви ст҃ы́и непощадѣ́вше, къ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: плоти и крови стыи непощадевше к всякому мучению
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Пло́ти, и҆ кро́ви ст҃ы́и непощадѣ́вше, къ вся́комꙋ мꙋче́нїю ста́сте небоя́зненни, Хрⷭ҇та не ѿмета́ющеся. Тѣ́мже съ Нб҃съ ниспосла̀ Хс҃ вамъ вѣ́нца :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Not sparing flesh and blood, O holy ones, ye stood without fear against every torment, not denying Christ; therefore from the heavens has Christ sent down crowns upon you!

units.slavonic_incipit: Трⷪ҇це ст҃ая сла́влю тя, є҆стество̀ безна́чальное,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: трце стая славлю тя естество безначальное единаго бга
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Трⷪ҇це ст҃ая сла́влю тя, є҆стество̀ безна́чальное, є҆ди́наго Бг҃а и҆ є҆ди́наго Гдⷭ҇а, трѝ лица̀ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆ Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а, нерожденна, рожденна, и҆сходна, не созда́нна же, и҆ присносꙋ́щна :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Trinity Troparion:* O Holy Trinity, I glorify Thee, unoriginate Essence, one God and one Lord, three Persons: Father, Son, and Spirit; unbegotten, begotten, and proceeding; uncreated and co-eternal!

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: о земля создавый мя и ожививый мя и
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆ земля̀ созда́вый мя, и҆ ѡ҆живи́вый мя, и҆ к землѝ возврати́ти ми ся па́ки рекі́й. ꙗ҆́же прїя́лъ є҆сѝ рабы̑ своя̀ ᲂу҆поко́й, и҆ тля̀ сме́ртныя свободѝ Гдⷭ҇и.

units.slavonic_incipit: И҆рмо́. Согрѣше́нїй бꙋ́рею погружа́емъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ въ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ирмо согрешений бурею погружаем ко в чреве китове

units.slavonic_incipit: Ѡ҆бо́лкшеся стрⷭ҇цы въ нетлѣ́нїе Бж҃тве́нное, ѡ҆бнаже́нїемъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: оболкшеся стрцы в нетление бжтвенное обнажением тленныя плоти
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆бо́лкшеся стрⷭ҇цы въ нетлѣ́нїе Бж҃тве́нное, ѡ҆бнаже́нїемъ тлѣ́нныя пло́ти, на́съ дѣ́ля пло́ть ѿ нетлѣ́нныя прїе́мшомꙋ жены̀, нн҃ѣ предстоитѐ свѣ́тлі́и. Сегѡ̀ ра́ди мя ѡ҆блецы́те въ ѡ҆де́ждꙋ чⷭ҇тꙋ́ю, ѡ҆бнаже́ннаго зло́бою :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having clothed yourselves in divine incorruption by the stripping off of corruptible flesh, O Passion-bearers, ye now stand radiant before Him Who for our sake received flesh from an incorrupt woman; therefore clothe me in a pure garment, who have been stripped bare by malice!

units.slavonic_incipit: Воздержа́нїемъ пожи́вый, стрⷭ҇ческі́й Собо́ръ, воздержа́нїя по́прище,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: воздержанием поживый стрческий собор воздержания поприще укрепите терпи
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Воздержа́нїемъ пожи́вый, стрⷭ҇ческі́й Собо́ръ, воздержа́нїя по́прище, ᲂу҆крѣпи́те терпѝ невозбра́ннѡ, ꙗ҆́кѡ проповѣ́давый Ха̀, на сꙋ́дищи мꙋ́жески, и҆ предстоѝ Сꙋдїи́ вѣнцено́сный въ наслажде́нїи мы́сленнѡ съ А҆́гглы :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* O company of Passion-bearers that lived in abstinence, do ye unhindered strengthen us to endure the course of abstinence, as ye proclaimed Christ manfully in the judgment hall, and now stand crowned before the Judge in spiritual delight with the Angels!

units.slavonic_incipit: Мл҃твами Бж҃е твои́ ст҃ы́хъ Мч҃нкъ, ᲂу҆со́пшыя
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: млтвами бже твои стых мчнк усопшыя верно упокой
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Мл҃твами Бж҃е твои́ ст҃ы́хъ Мч҃нкъ, ᲂу҆со́пшыя вѣ́рнѡ ᲂу҆поко́й, и҆ Ра́еви жи́теля покажѝ, и҆ свѣ́тꙋ мы́сленномꙋ сподо́би и҆́хъ, непреста́ннѡ зовꙋ́щихъ ти, бл҃венъ Бг҃ъ ѡ҆те́цъ на́шихъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *For the Departed:* *Troparion:* By the prayers of Thy holy Martyrs, O God, grant rest in faith unto those that have fallen asleep; show them to be citizens of Paradise, and vouchsafe them Thy spiritual light, as they unceasingly cry unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

units.slavonic_incipit: Тебѐ є҆ди́нꙋ бл҃гꙋ́ю мл҃имъ Дв҃о, ѡ҆зло́бленныя
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тебе едину блгую млим дво озлобленныя ны ублжи
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Тебѐ є҆ди́нꙋ бл҃гꙋ́ю мл҃имъ Дв҃о, ѡ҆зло́бленныя ны ᲂу҆бл҃жѝ, и҆ приле́жнѡ Ха̀ мл҃и, є҆стество́мъ сꙋ́ща бл҃га́го воздержа́нїя вре́мя, бл҃га́я творя́щи, сконча́ти намъ пою́щимъ є҆гѡ̀, бл҃венъ Бг҃ъ ѡ҆́цъ на́шихъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* *Theotokion:* Thee alone, the good one, do we pray, O Virgin: bless us who are afflicted, and diligently pray Christ, Who is good by nature, that we may complete the time of abstinence doing good deeds, as we sing unto Him: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Безсме́ртномꙋ Цр҃ю̀ во́инствовавше, и҆ въ вѣ́рѣ к нему̀ показа́вше соверше́нную, кро́вь свою̀ мч҃нци за нь и҆злїя́сте, моли́те є҆гѡ̀ сп҃ти́ся на́мъ :~

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: великоименныи хви стрцы и чтнии в бзе всех
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Великоиме́нныи Хв҃и стрⷭ҇цы, и҆ чⷭ҇тні́и въ Бз҃ѣ, всѣ́хъ воспѣва́ющихъ па́мяти ва́ша, вели́кихъ съгрѣше́нїй, и҆ та́мошнихъ мꙋ́къ, и҆зба́вите на́съ, к не́мꙋ вели́кими мл҃твами ва́шими :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* O renowned Passion-bearers of Christ, and honored in God: from great transgressions and from the torments yonder, deliver all of us who celebrate your memory, by your great prayers unto Him!

units.slavonic_incipit: Ѻ҆до́брое совокꙋпле́нїе, ѡ҆брѣто́сте сме́ртїю живо́тъ, сщ҃енномч҃ннци
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: доброе совокупление обретосте смертию живот сщенномчннци хви гня
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆до́брое совокꙋпле́нїе, ѡ҆брѣто́сте сме́ртїю живо́тъ, сщ҃енномч҃ннци Хв҃и, ѻ҆гнѧ̀ и҆ меча̀, * мра́за и҆ ѕвѣре́й, ника́коже ᲂу҆боѧ́вшесѧ, и҆ вопїю́ще * по́йте Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозноси́те въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки: ⁓ Го́рѣ ли́къ А҆́гг҃льскїй, до́лѣ же мы земноро́днїи, * хва́лимъ Мч҃нци Хв҃и, стра́ннаѧ стрⷭ҇тїѧ и҆ по́двиги ва́шегѡ мꙋ́жества, блгⷭ҇вѧще, пою́ще Гдⷭ҇а, * и҆ превозносѧ́ще є҆гѡ̀ въ вѣ́ки. ⁓ *Трⷪ҇ичъ.*

The earth and all that is on it, the sea and all springs, the heaven of heavens, light and darkness, frost and heat, ye sons of men, ye priests: bless the Lord and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

units.slavonic_incipit: Хв҃и стрⷭ҇лцы, но и҆зба́вите насъ ѿ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: хви стрлцы но избавите нас от стрел лу
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Хв҃и стрⷭ҇лцы, но и҆зба́вите насъ ѿ стрѣ́лъ лꙋ- ка́вагѡ, застꙋпле́нїемъ ва́шимъ: ⁓ Поко́й ще́дре въ нѣ́дрехъ А҆враа́мовыхъ, рабы̑ твоѧ̑ вѣ́рою ѿна́съ ѿше́дшыѧ, к тебѐ бл҃гоꙋтро́бномꙋ зижди́телю и҆ пребл҃го́мꙋ: ⁓ *Бг҃оро́диченъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *For the Departed:* *Troparion:* Give rest, O compassionate One, in the bosom of Abraham, unto Thy servants who have departed from us in faith unto Thee, the tenderhearted Creator and most good!

units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* We all hymn your memories, O all-praised Martyrs, beholding the struggles of your sacred passions, and we magnify Christ Who has done marvelous things!

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: на горе хртос благословляе монахов що сходят
units.slavonic_diplomatic: [Деревори́тна і҆люстра́цїѧ: Лѣ́ствица бж҃е́ственнагѡ восхожде́нїѧ прпⷣбнагѡ І҆ѡа́нна Лѣ́ствичника, граве́ръ ма́йстеръ І҆лїа̀ (моногра́ма «І҆ЛЇА АЗ» та лѣ́то «҂АХМ» [1640]). На горѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́съ благословля́є мона́хѡвъ, що схо́дѧть драби́ною; бѣ́си скида́ють грѣ́шникѡвъ въ па́ще адꙋ; на до́лѣ стоѧ́ть мона́си предъ монастире́мъ «СТ҃А ЛѢ́СТВ».]
units.english_cohort_translation: [Woodcut illustration: The Ladder of Divine Ascent of our Venerable Father John Climacus, engraved by Master Ilia (inscribed with monogram "ILIA AZ" and date "1640" [AXM]). units.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 1:* O venerable Father John, thou didst truly bear the praises of God continually in thy throat [Ps. 149:6 LXX], meditating all-wisely on the most practical, divinely inspired words; and from the grace flowing thence thou hast been enriched, becoming blessed, casting down the counsels of all the ungodly!

units.slavonic_incipit: (fol. 602) Ѻ҆́тче І҆ѡа́нне пресла́вне, сле́зъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 602 тче иоанне преславне слез источниками душу
units.slavonic_diplomatic: (fol. 602) Ѻ҆́тче І҆ѡа́нне пресла́вне, сле́зъ и҆сто́чниками дꙋ́шꙋ * ѡ҆чи́стилъ, и҆ всено́щными стоѧ́нїи Бг҃а ᲂу҆млⷭ҇тиви́въ, * воспѣри́лсѧ є҆сѝ, къ любле́нїю сегѡ̀ бл҃же́ннѣй красотѣ̀, * є҆ѧ́же досто́йнѡ нн҃ѣ наслажда́ешисѧ, безконе́чнѡ ра́дꙋѧсѧ, съ стрⷭ҇лцы твои́ми, Бг҃оно́се Прпⷣбне: ⁓ Ѻ҆́тче І҆ѡа́нне Прпⷣбне, воспѣри́въ ᲂу҆́мъ къ Бг҃ꙋ вѣ́рою, мїрска́гѡ смѣше́нїѧ ѡ҆мерзи́лъ є҆сѝ непо- стоѧ́нное, и҆ крⷭ҇тъ тво́й воспрїи́мъ, всеви́дцꙋ послѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ, тѣ́ло неѡбꙋ́зданное, по́двигами ѡ҆бꙋче́нїѧ, по́мысломъ крѣ́пости поработи́въ
units.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 2:* O all-glorious Father John, having cleansed thy soul with fountains of tears, and having propitiated God by all-night vigils, thou didst soar on wings unto the love of His blessed beauty, which now thou dost worthily enjoy, endlessly rejoicing with thy fellow ascetics, O God-bearing venerable one!

units.slavonic_incipit: Прпⷣбне Ѻ҆́тче, гла́са Є҆ѵ҃лїа Гдⷭ҇нѧ послꙋ́шавъ,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: прпбне тче гласа еилиа гдня послушав мир
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Прпⷣбне Ѻ҆́тче, гла́са Є҆ѵ҃лїа Гдⷭ҇нѧ послꙋ́шавъ, * мї́ръ ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ, бога́тство и҆ сла́вꙋ нивочто́же вмѣни́въ. ѿню́дꙋже всѣ̑мъ возопи́лъ є҆сѝ, воз- люби́те Бг҃а, и҆ ѡ҆брѧ́щете блгⷣть вѣ́чнꙋю, ничто́же препочти́те любвѐ є҆гѡ̀, да є҆гда̀ прїи́детъ въ сла́вѣ свое́й, ѡ҆брѧ́щете ᲂу҆покое́нїе, со всѣ́ми ст҃ы́ми, * и҆́хже мл҃твами Хе҃ сохранѝ и҆ сп҃сѝ дꙋ́шѧ на́шѧ: ⁓
units.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 3:* O venerable Father John, having borne aloft thy mind unto God by faith, thou didst abhor the unstable confusion of the world; and having taken up thy cross, thou didst follow the All-seeing One, subjecting the unbridled body to the Divine Spirit through the struggles of discipline by steadfastness of thought!

units.english_cohort_translation: *Doxasticon:* O venerable Father, having heeded the voice of the Gospel of the Lord, thou didst forsake the world, counting wealth and glory as naught. Whence thou didst cry aloud unto all: "Love God, and ye shall find eternal grace; prefer nothing before His love, so that when He comes in His glory, ye may find rest with all the saints; by whose prayers, O Christ, preserve and save our souls!"

units.slavonic_diplomatic: На землѝ А҆́гг҃ла, и҆ на нб҃се́хъ чл҃вка Бж҃їѧ, мї́рꙋ бл҃гоꙋкраше́нїе, наслажде́нїе бл҃ги́хъ, добродѣ́телей по́стнически похва́лꙋ, І҆ѡа́нна почти́мъ. возраще́н бо в̾ до́мꙋ Бж҃їи процвнтѐ првⷣнѡ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ ке́дръ въ пꙋсты́ни, ᲂу҆мно́жи ста́да Хв҃а слове́сныхъ ѡ҆ве́цъ, *
units.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron:* Let us honor John: an angel on earth and a man of God in the heavens, the adornment of the world, the enjoyment of good things, the boast of ascetic virtues! For planted in the house of God he blossomed righteously, and like a cedar in the wilderness, he multiplied the flocks of Christ's rational sheep in holiness and righteousness![^1663]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Тропа́рь, Гла́съ, д҃.* Пꙋсты́ни граждани́нъ, и҆ въ пло́ти А҆́гг҃лъ, и҆ чꙋдотво́рецъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ І҆ѡа́нне Ѻ҆́тче на́шъ, по́стомъ, * бдѣ́нїемъ, и҆ мл҃твою, нб҃наѧ дарова́нїѧ прїи́мъ, и҆сцѣлѧ́еши недꙋ́жныѧ, и҆ дꙋ́шѧ вѣ́рою приходѧ́щихъ ти. Сла́ва да́вшомꙋ тебѣ̀ крѣ́пость, сла́ва вѣнча́вшомꙋ тѧ̀, сла́ва дѣ́йствꙋющомꙋ тобо́ю всѣ̑мъ и҆сцѣле́нїа: ⁓
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion, Tone 4:* *Troparion:* A citizen of the wilderness, an angel in the flesh, and a wonderworker hast thou been shown to be, O John our Father! Having received heavenly gifts through fasting, vigilance, and prayer, thou healest the diseased and the souls of those who come unto thee in faith. Glory to Him Who gave thee strength! Glory to Him Who crowned thee! Glory to Him Who works healings for all through thee!

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS :: On Saturday evening, after the customary psalmody [kathisma]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At "God is the Lord": Resurrection Troparion, twice. Glory: to the saints. Both now: Resurrection Theotokion according to the Tone of the Troparion of the saints. After the kathismata: Resurrection Sessional Hymns with their Theotokia, and reading from the Commentary Gospel; and the Evlogitaria [Amomos] with their troparia. Hypakoe of the Tone, and reading from the Gospel. Polyeleos; Sessional Hymns of the saints, twice. Glory, both now: Theotokion; and reading for the saints. Hymns of Ascent of the Tone. Prokeimenon. Resurrection Gospel. Psalm 50. Glory: Sticheron, Tone 8: "Open the doors of repentance" (Покая́нїѧ ѿве́рзи ми), and the rest. Canons: Resurrection on 4; and in the Triodion on 4; and for the Martyrs on 6. [Or thus: Resurrection Canon on 4; and for the Theotokos on 4; and both canons for the Martyrs on 8.][^1666] Katavasia: "I shall open my mouth" (Ѿве́рзꙋ ᲂу҆ста̀). After Ode 3: Sessional Hymns of the saints, twice. Glory, both now: Theotokion; and reading for the martyrs. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the saints, and Ikos. After Ode 9: Resurrection Exapostilarion. Glory: for the Martyrs. Both now: Resurrection Theotokion.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Saturday evening, at Small Vespers: At "Lord, I have cried": Stichera of the feast, on 4, Tone 4, Podoben: "Being called from on high" (Зва́ный свы́шше):[^1669] Sticheron 1: "Having mercy on creation"; twice. Sticheron 2: "A strange thing it is"; Sticheron 3: "In Nazareth now." Glory, both now: Tone 4: "In the sixth month." At the Aposticha: stichera of the feast, Tone 2, Podoben: "O most marvelous wonder" (Ѡ҆ пресла́вное): Sticheron 1: "The Prince of the heavenly powers"; verse or refrain: "Proclaim the good tidings from day to day of the salvation of God" [Ps. 95:2 LXX]. Sticheron 2: "What is this fiery vision of thine?"; Refrain 2: "Sing unto the Lord a new song" [Ps. 95:1 LXX]. Sticheron 3: "The Holy Spirit of God." Glory, both now: Tone 4: "In the sixth month." After the Trisagion: Troparion of the feast, Tone 4: "Today is the fountainhead of our salvation." Little Litany, and Dismissal.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers: After the Evening Psalm [Psalm 103]: "Blessed is the man," the entire Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried": Resurrection stichera, 3; and Anatolian, 1; and of the feast, 6. Glory: Tone 6: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Both now: Dogmatic Theotokion of Tone 1. Entrance. Prokeimenon of the day. Readings of the feast, 3: First: "Moses went into the tent" [Ex. 3:1-8]; Second: "The Lord created Me" [Prov. 8:22-30]; Third: "It shall come to pass from the eighth day" [Ezek. 43:27-44:4].[^1670] At the Litiya: Stichera of the feast, all. At the Aposticha: Resurrection stichera. Glory, both now: for the feast, Tone 4: "Today is the joy of the Annunciation." At the blessing of the loaves: Troparion of the feast, thrice; and reading from the Epistles of the Apostles.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS :: On Saturday evening, after the customary psalmody [kathisma]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins: At "God is the Lord": Resurrection Troparion, twice. Glory, both now: of the feast. After the kathismata: Resurrection Sessional Hymns with their Theotokia, and reading from the Commentary Gospel. Then the Evlogitaria [Amomos]. Hypakoe of the Tone, and reading from the Gospel. Polyeleos; and Sessional Hymns of the feast, all once; and reading for the feast. Hymns of Ascent of the Tone. Prokeimenon and Gospel of the feast. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ." Psalm 50. Sticheron of the feast. Canon: Resurrection with Theotokion on 6, and of the feast on 8. Katavasia: Heirmos of the feast, both choirs together. After Ode 3: Sessional Hymns of the feast. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the feast and Ikos, and reading in the Prologue. At Ode 9: We sing "More honorable." Exapostilaria: Resurrection and of the feast. At the Praises: stichera on 8: Resurrection, 4; and of the feast, sung on 4: With end-rhymed acrostics: "The co-eternal Word"; "Gabriel to the Virgin"; "The transcendent Word." And the Sticheron of the feast appointed for Glory: we sing it with the verse: "Proclaim the good tidings from day to day of the salvation of our God," Tone 2: "The mystery from all eternity." We sing the verse: "Arise, O Lord my God, let Thy hand be lifted up" [Ps. 9:33 LXX], and we sing the idiomelon of the day from the Triodion. Glory: the same again. Both now: "Most blessed art thou." Great Doxology. After the Trisagion: Little Entrance with the Gospel...*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS :: On Saturday evening, after the customary psalmody [kathisma]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Saturday evening, at Small Vespers, as usual. At Great Vespers: the first Kathisma, "Blessed is the man," all. At "Lord, I have cried": Stichera: Resurrection, 3; and Anatolian, 1; and of the feast, 3; and for the Archangel, 3. Glory: of the feast: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Both now: Dogmatic Theotokion of Tone 1. At the Litiya: for the saint whose temple it is, and of the feast, 3, Tone 4, which are at the Aposticha. Glory, both now: Tone 2: "Gabriel proclaims the good tidings." At the Aposticha: Resurrection stichera. Glory, both now: of the feast, Tone 4: "Today is the joy." At the blessing of the loaves: Troparion: "Theotokos Virgin," thrice; and reading from the Epistles.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS :: On Saturday evening, after the customary psalmody [kathisma]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins: At "God is the Lord": Resurrection Troparion, twice. Glory, both now: of the feast. After both kathismata: Resurrection Sessional Hymns with their Theotokia, and the Evlogitaria [Amomos]. Hypakoe. Hymns of Ascent of the Tone. Prokeimenon: of the Resurrection. "Let every breath." Resurrection Gospel, and the rest. Canons: Resurrection on 4; and of the feast on 6; and for the Archangel on 4. Katavasia: of the feast. After Ode 3: Kontakion and Sessional Hymn for the Archangel. Glory, both now: of the feast. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the feast. At Ode 9 we sing "More honorable." Exapostilarion: Resurrection. Glory: for the Archangel. Both now: of the feast. At the Praises: Resurrection, 4; and of the feast, 3; and the idiomelon of the feast with its verse, Tone 8: "Let the heavens rejoice." Then verse: "Arise, O Lord my God" [Ps. 9:33 LXX]; and the idiomelon of the day. Glory: the same. Both now: "Most blessed art thou." Great Doxology. Resurrection Troparion, litany, and the catechesis of Theodore the Studite; and Dismissal. The customary procession. Glory, both now: Gospel Sticheron; and First Hour in the narthex.*

units.slavonic_incipit: Въ свѣ́тъ невеще́ственный и҆ ᲂу҆́мный, ѿ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в свет невещественный и умный от печали вещественных
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ свѣ́тъ невеще́ственный и҆ ᲂу҆́мный, ѿ печа́ли веще́ственныхъ восте́къ І҆ѡа́нне Прпⷣбне, мл҃твами твои́ми къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ просвѣти́ мѧ: ⁓ Ꙗ҆́кѡ воздержа́нїа сла́дость ѣ҆́дъ, ѿри́нꙋлъ є҆сѝ го́ресть сласте́й. тѣ́мже па́че ме́да и҆ со́та ᲂу҆слажда́еши, Ѻ҆́тче чꙋ́вьства на́ша: ⁓
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having tasted the sweetness of abstinence, thou didst cast away the bitterness of pleasures; therefore more than honey and the honeycomb dost thou sweeten our senses, O Father!

units.slavonic_incipit: Добродѣ́телми возсїѧ́въ, водрꙋже́нныѧ къ нб҃сѝ, возве́лъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: добродетелми возсияв водруженныя к нбси возвел еси к
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Добродѣ́телми возсїѧ́въ, водрꙋже́нныѧ къ нб҃сѝ, возве́лъ є҆сѝ къ Бг҃овидѣ́нїа неизмѣ́римой глꙋбинѣ̀ бл҃гчⷭ҇тнѡ, всѧ̑ ᲂу҆́бѡ побѣди́въ дѣ́монскїѧ ко́зни, застꙋпа́еши же чл҃вки ѿ досажде́нїа си́хъ, Їѡа́нне лѣ́ствице добродѣ́телей, и҆ны́нѣ млⷭ҇ящисѧ сп҃тисѧ рабѡ́мъ твои́мъ :~

units.slavonic_incipit: На прⷭ҇тлѣ Херꙋві́мскомъ сѣдѧ́й, и҆ въ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: на пртле херувимском седяй и в недрах цих
units.slavonic_diplomatic: На прⷭ҇тлѣ Херꙋві́мскомъ сѣдѧ́й, и҆ въ нѣ́драхъ Ѻ҆ц҃ихъ во- дворѧ́ѧйсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ на прⷭ҇тлѣ сѣди́тъ ст҃о́мъ свое́мъ Влⷣчце, въ нѣ́дрехъ твои́хъ, пло́тски Бг҃ъ, воцр҃и́выйсѧ та́кѡ надъ всѣ́ми ꙗ҆зы́ки, и҆ разꙋ́мнѡ ны́нѣ пое́мъ емꙋ̀: є҆го́же и҆ ты̀ Чⷭ҇таѧ молѝ, сп҃ти́сѧ рабѡ́мъ твои́мъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: He Who sits upon the Cherubic throne and abides in the bosom of the Father, sits as upon His holy throne in thy womb, O Sovereign Lady, God in the flesh, Who hath thus reigned over all nations; and with understanding do we now sing unto Him, Whom do thou also, O pure one, entreat that thy servants may be saved!

units.english_text: He Who sits upon the Cherubic throne and abides in the bosom of the Father, sits as upon His holy throne in thy womb, O Sovereign Lady, God in the flesh, Who hath thus reigned over all nations; and with understanding do we now sing unto Him, Whom do thou also, O pure one, entreat that thy servants may be saved!

units.slavonic_incipit: По лѣ́то быва́ема, ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безлѣ́тнѡ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: лето бываема от ца безлетно возсиявша бгомти
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. По лѣ́то быва́ема, ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безлѣ́тнѡ возсїѧ́вша, Бг҃омт҃и на́мъ родила є҆сѝ, є҆го́же молѝ сп҃тѝ пою́щыѧ тѧ̀ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* *Theotokion:* Him Who became subject to time, Who shone forth timelessly from the Father, hast thou borne unto us, O Mother of God; Whom do thou entreat to save those who hymn thee!

units.slavonic_incipit: И҆́же посѣтѝ ра́ны дꙋша̀ моеѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡже

units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having quenched all passions with the dew of thy struggles, O blessed Father, thou wast abundantly kindled with the fire of love and faith, a lamp of abstinence and the enlightenment of dispassion, and thou didst become a son of the day!

units.slavonic_incipit: Претерпѣ́въ до́блѣ навѣ́ты и҆ ꙗ҆́звы проти́вныхъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: претерпев добле наветы и звы противных врагов вился
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Претерпѣ́въ до́блѣ навѣ́ты и҆ ꙗ҆́звы проти́вныхъ врагѡ́въ, ꙗ҆ви́лся є҆сѝ сто́лпъ терпѣ́нїѧ, ᲂу҆твержда́ѧи ста́до своє̀, жезло́мъ Бж҃твеннымъ, на па́жити воздержа́нїѧ, и҆ на водѣ̀ воспитова́ѧ бл҃же́нне :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having bravely endured the assaults and wounds of the adversary enemies, thou hast appeared as a pillar of patience, establishing thy flock with the divine staff upon the pasture of abstinence, and nourishing it upon the water, O blessed one!

units.slavonic_incipit: До́момъ Бж҃їимъ ꙗ҆́кѡже и҆́стиннымъ, сама́го себѐ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: домом бжиим коже истинным самаго себе со делал
units.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ. До́момъ Бж҃їимъ ꙗ҆́кѡже и҆́стиннымъ, сама́го себѐ со- дѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ Ѻ҆́ч҃е, Бж҃твенными добродѣ́телми твои́ми, ꙗ҆́вственнѡ ᲂу҆краси́въ ꙗ҆́кѡже зла́то свѣ́тлое, Вѣ́рꙋ, Наде́ждꙋ и҆ Любо́вь и҆́стиннꙋю, Бж҃твенныѧ зако́ны и҆злага́ѧ, воздер- жа́нїемъ ѡ҆бꙋчи́всѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ безпло́тный, мꙋ́рость, мꙋ́жество, цѣломꙋ́дрїе стѧжа́въ, и҆ смѣре́нїе, и҆́миже возне́слѧ є҆сѝ, тѣ́мже и҆ просвѣти́лся є҆сѝ мл҃твами непреста́нными, и҆ нбⷭ҇наѧ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ селе́нїа, наста́вниче Їѡа́нне Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* As a true house of God hast thou fashioned thyself, O Father, by thy divine virtues, manifestly adorning, even as radiant gold, Faith, Hope, and true Love; setting forth divine laws, training thyself in abstinence as an incorporeal one, having acquired prudence, courage, chastity, and humility, whereby thou wast exalted; therefore thou wast also enlightened by unceasing prayers, and hast received heavenly habitations, O our father and teacher John!

units.slavonic_incipit: Ко́торое бы того̀ Бж҃твенногѡ мꙋ́жа мѣ́сто
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: которое бы того бжтвенного мужа место принесло и
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ко́торое бы того̀ Бж҃твенногѡ мꙋ́жа мѣ́сто принесло̀, и҆ препресла́внымъ в не́номъ жо́лнѣрствѣ цвиче́нїемъ вы́ховало, не ла́тво бымъ повѣ́далъ, гды́жъ ми то не досы́тъ пи́лно вѣ́домо є҆́стъ. Кото́рое за́сь тепе́ръ є҆гѡ̀ но́ситъ, и҆ вѣ́чными и҆ несме́р- телными ро́скошами пасе́тъ, дале́ко пере́ на́ми Па́велъ ст҃ы́й вырази́лъ. Зго́ла бовѣ́мъ и҆ ѻ҆́нъ нб҃ногѡ ѻ҆́ногѡ І҆ерꙋсали́ма зоста́лъ мешка́нцемъ, в кото́ромъ цр҃квъ Перворо́дныхъ є҆́стъ: Кото́рыи, [margin: Євр: в҃і.]
units.english_cohort_translation: Which city or land brought forth that divine man, and reared him with most glorious training in spiritual warfare, I could not easily recount, since this is not with sufficient certainty known unto me. But which city now holds him, and pastures him with eternal and immortal delights, Saint Paul hath long before us expressed. For altogether hath he also become an inhabitant of that heavenly Jerusalem, in which is the assembly of the firstborn: whose habitation, he says, is in the heavens (Heb. 12:22–23),[^1689] where unto the most refined spirits...

units.slavonic_incipit: То́тъ ст҃ы́й, гды́ пре́взро́стъ теле́сный, в
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тот стый гды превзрост телесный в шестнадцатех немал
units.slavonic_diplomatic: То́тъ ст҃ы́й, гды́ пре́взро́стъ теле́сный, в шестна́дцатехъ нема́ль бы́лъ лѣ́техъ, себѐ прине́съ Хꙋ̀ ѡ҆фѣ́рꙋ вдѧ́чнꙋю и҆ прїе́мнꙋю, ꙗ҆́рмъ И҆́ноческагѡ житїѧ̀ шїин поклада́ючи на горѣ̀ Сїна́йской, ты́мъ мнима́ѧ ᲂу҆́мысломъ, же́бы ты́мъ ви́домомъ мѣ́сца ме́шканьемъ напо́мненый, до неви́домомгѡ Бг҃а ла́твѣй бы́лъ ᲂу҆пра́вованый и҆ спосо́бнѣй прова́женый. И҆ страсткова́нїе ꙗ҆́кѡ ро́зꙋмꙋ ча́стей наᲂу҆чи́телѧ, на́продъ ᲂу҆ленчи́лъ, пре кото́рое, спро́снꙋю и҆ шкодли́вꙋю вшеля́кꙋю ᲂу҆́фность ѿкину́вши, поко́рꙋ найту́тнѣйшꙋю принѧ́въши, вѣ́са ѻ҆́ного, ш кото́рого подꙋ́лъ, жебы́смы собѣ̀ подоба́лися и҆ собѣ̀ ᲂу҆фа́ли, ко́жены быва́емъ.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...and separated from all matter, insatiably enjoying divine good things, contemplating invisible beauties, he receives worthy tokens of his sweats, and carries off the most peaceful reward of his labors. For having attained the inheritance of that Kingdom, he now dances in chorus with them unto ages, and makes merry with those whose foot hath stood in uprightness (Ps. 25:12 LXX).[^1690] In what manner, then, he prepared this blessedness for himself, I will now begin to speak.

For having attained the inheritance of that Kingdom, he now dances in chorus with them unto ages, and makes merry with those whose foot hath stood in uprightness (Ps. 25:12 LXX).[^1690] In what manner, then, he prepared this blessedness for himself, I will now begin to speak.

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source:
То́тъ ст҃ы́й, гды́ пре́взро́стъ теле́сный, в шестна́дцатехъ
нема́ль бы́лъ лѣ́техъ, себѐ прине́съ Хꙋ̀ ѡ҆фѣ́рꙋ вдѧ́чнꙋю и҆ прїе́мнꙋю,
ꙗ҆́рмъ И҆́ноческагѡ житїѧ̀ шїин поклада́ючи на горѣ̀ Сїна́йской,
ты́мъ мнима́ѧ ᲂу҆́мысломъ, же́бы ты́мъ ви́домомъ мѣ́сца
ме́шканьемъ напо́мненый, до неви́домомгѡ Бг҃а ла́твѣй бы́лъ
ᲂу҆пра́вованый и҆ спосо́бнѣй прова́женый. И҆ страсткова́нїе ꙗ҆́кѡ
ро́зꙋмꙋ ча́стей наᲂу҆чи́телѧ, на́продъ ᲂу҆ленчи́лъ, пре кото́рое,
спро́снꙋю и҆ шкодли́вꙋю вшеля́кꙋю ᲂу҆́фность ѿкину́вши, поко́рꙋ
найту́тнѣйшꙋю принѧ́въши, вѣ́са ѻ҆́ного, ш кото́рого подꙋ́лъ,
жебы́смы собѣ̀ подоба́лися и҆ собѣ̀ ᲂу҆фа́ли, ко́жены быва́емъ.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: А накланя́ючи ши́ю и҆ ᲂу҆фа́ючи въ Гдⷭ҇ѣ и҆ томꙋ̀ кото́рый є҆гѡ̀ при- на́лежалъ Ѻ҆ц҃еви, ꙗ҆́кѡ найлѣ́пшомꙋ нѣ́якомꙋ спра́вци себѐ ца́лого позволя́ючи, [margin: в ба́рзо великои є҆го послꙋша́нїе.] ба́рзо глꙋбо́кїи и҆ сро́гїи живота̀ тꙋ- те́шнегѡ валы̀ бе́зъ небезпече́нства перебыва́лъ. И҆ та́къ доскона́ле свѣ́тꙋ и҆ вла́снымъ во́лямъ ᲂу҆́меръ, же нѣ́якове́ не ма́ючꙋю ро́зꙋмꙋ и҆ во́ли зда́лся мѣ́ти дꙋ́шꙋ, и҆ вла́сности прирожо́нои вше́ляки во́лнꙋю. А то сна́ть чудоднѣ́йшая є҆́стъ, же пре тое́ю не́ною простото́ю в свѣ́цкои мꙋ́дрости до́бре бы́лъ цви́тоный.
units.english_cohort_translation: This holy man, when he attained bodily growth, being scarcely sixteen years of age,[^1691] offered himself unto Christ as a pleasing and acceptable sacrifice, placing his neck under the yoke of monastic life upon Mount Sinai. He thought in his mind that, being admonished by the visible dwelling of that place, he might be more easily trained and more fitly led unto the invisible God. And first the holy man tamed the insolence of passions, as the frequent instructor of the mind; whereby, casting away all foul and harmful presumption, and having embraced the deepest humility, he drove completely far from himself that demon of self-satisfaction by whose blast we are each moved to please ourselves and trust ourselves; and even the very beast he cast out from his heart. And bending his neck, trusting in the Lord and yielding himself entirely unto the Father who had taken him under his care,[^1692] as unto some best governor, [margin: In very great obedience] he passed through the very deep and fierce billows of this present life without danger. And so perfectly did he die unto the world and his own wills that he seemed to have a soul devoid of any reasoning and will, and entirely free of natural self-assertion. And this, indeed, was most marvelous: that along with that simple guilelessness, he was well trained in secular learning; for the conceit of philosophy is far removed from the humility of Christ, as are many other things.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѧ́тымъ те́ды цїаркве ка́менемъ, во́йны свое́и домо́къ по- ста́новилъ, на мѣ́сцу котро́мꙋ Ѳѡ́ла и҆́мѧ є҆́стъ. И҆ та́мъ чотырдесѧ́тъ лѣ́тъ, в ба́рзо велико́й срⷣца велико́сти и҆ ꙗ҆́сности пережи́лъ, найгоря́тшею мл҃твою и҆ Бо́зскою любвѐ ѻ҆гне́мъ ᲂу҆ста́вичне пала́ючи. Нꙋ́ жъ кто мо́жетъ, ꙗ҆́къ вели́кїи та́мъ знёслъ пра́цы, го́дне ане́з сло́вы, ане́з хва́лами вы́словити;
units.english_cohort_translation: Nineteen years, then, he lived thus, becoming unto all a pattern of blessed obedience. And when that holy elder who trained him departed unto Christ, he also went forth unto the discipline of the eremitic life [margin: Departing unto solitude], supported by the elder's prayers as by a most powerful weapon, for the destruction of the strongholds of Satan. At the fifth milestone from the church,[^1693] then, he established the dwelling-place of his warfare, at a place whose name is Tholas.[^1694] And there he lived for forty years, in very great greatness and clarity of heart, continually burning with most fervent prayer and the fire of divine love. Now, who could worthily express in words or praises what great labors he endured there?

units.slavonic_incipit: Лѣни́вства зась и҆ ᲂу҆мы́слꙋ сла́бости (кото́рꙋю
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ленивства зас и умыслу слабости которую слушне власною
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Лѣни́вства зась и҆ ᲂу҆мы́слꙋ сла́бости (кото́рꙋю слꙋ́шне вла́сною дꙋши́ сме́рти назва́лъ бымъ), сме́рти па́мѧтю, и҆ цвиче́ньемсѧ въ ᲂу҆стави́тномъ Набоже́нствѣ ᲂу҆бѣ́гъ и҆ ᲂу҆стере́гсѧ. И҆ гды́ жа́дною сме́ртельною ре́чи пожада́ньем не бы́лъ зна́тый, и҆ вѣ́чны то́лко до́бръ ᲂу҆тѣ́мъ напаса́лся, ѿ шкодли́вогѡ фра́снꙋкꙋ во́льнымъ ᲂу҆шо́лъ. Гнѣ́вливости зась тира́нство в само́мъ собѣ̀ мече́мъ послꙋше́нїства заби́лъ бы́лъ. Рѣ́дкимъ зась хоже́ньемсѧ тѣла̀, а҆ рѣ́дшимъ ᲂу҆жива́ньемъ мо́вы, про́жнои хвалы̀ пїѧ́вицꙋ, па́дꙋкꙋ найподобнѣ́йшꙋю ᲂу҆мори́лъ. Што́жъ ѡ҆ ѻ҆́смогѡ грѣха̀ найвы́шшомъ и҆ найпи́лнѣйшемъ ѡ҆чище́нньем, то́ є҆стъ Пы́хи, мо́вити бꙋ́дꙋ; кото́рое поча́лъ в пра́вдѣ пре́ скро́мность По- слꙋше́нїства Но́вый се́й Веселеи́лъ, а҆ доко́нчилъ нб҃ногѡ І҆ерл҃имꙋ
units.english_cohort_translation: He ate indeed of everything that was lawful for him according to the vows of his monastic rule [margin: Food], yet very moderately, so that he might also cut off conceited pride from thence and prudently break the horn of haughtiness [margin: * That he might quench sin in himself]; by the shortness indeed of his food completely tormenting the unhealthy madness of gluttony, and crying out unto it through abstinence: *Be silent, be muzzled!* And tasting moderately of all things, he sent the tyranny of vainglory under the yoke. By solitariness, through which he was rarely seen by men, he so quenched the flame of that furnace—that is to say, bodily pleasure—that it was utterly smothered and laid to rest, and brought him no vexations. And concupiscence (which the Apostle defined as idolatry, Eph. 5:5)[^1695] this mighty warrior mightily struck down by the fear of God and the smallness of earthly things. And as for sloth and faintheartedness of mind (which I would rightly call the very death of the soul), he escaped and guarded against them by the remembrance of death and by training in continual piety. And since he was not marked by longing for any mortal thing, but was fed only by the consolation of eternal goods, he escaped free from harmful anxiety. The tyranny of anger he had slain within himself with the sword of obedience. And by rare bodily movement and rarer use of speech, he starved the leech of vainglory, that most deceptive fall. What, then, shall I say concerning the highest and most diligent purification of the eighth sin—that is to say, Pride?[^1696] Which this new Bezalel[^1697] began indeed through the modesty of obedience, and the Lord of the heavenly Jerusalem brought unto perfection, coming in His presence and exalting humility against it, without which it is impossible to defeat the devil and his like pitfall.

units.english_cohort_translation: Where, then, shall I place that fountain of tears in the crown of his life? A thing truly rare, and one that is not easily found among many, whose secret workshop now remains: a very narrow cave situated at the foot of a certain mountain, and so far distant from his own and every other cell, as seemed necessary to preserve his ears from vainglory; reaching even unto heaven by groaning, sighing, weeping...

units.slavonic_incipit: Томꙋ̀ є҆дно́го ча́сꙋ ст҃ы́й ѻ҆ц҃ъ росказа́лъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тому едного часу стый ц росказал был жебы
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Томꙋ̀ є҆дно́го ча́сꙋ ст҃ы́й ѻ҆ц҃ъ росказа́лъ бы́лъ, же́бы з є҆дногѡ̀ мѣ́стца мате́рїи глеіова́тои землѣ̀ зноси́лъ, дла весе́лшого выправе́нѧ ѡ҆горо́дца и҆ ꙗ҆́ринъ, Переходѧ́чи те́ды Мѡѷсе́й до назна́чоногѡ собѣ̀ мѣ́стца, што росказа́но є҆мꙋ̀ чини́ти, не лѣ́ниво справова́лъ. А҆ле гды́ ю́жъ полꙋ́денный ча́съ пристꙋпи́лъ, и҆ пале́ньемъ слн҃ца, на кшта́лтъ пе́чи мѣ́сце ѻ҆́ное ꙗ҆́къ ѻ҆го́нь было̀ (бы́лъ ꙗ҆ковѣ́мъ мц҃ъ А҆ѵ́гꙋстъ.) збетѧже́ный Мѡѷсе́й, и҆ ѿ переноше́нѧ ᲂу҆працо́ваный, ᲂу҆тѧжа́етъ собѣ̀ ма́ленкогѡ ѡ҆почи́нкꙋ потре́бꙋ бы́ти: а҆ по́д тѣ́нь ба́рзо вели́когѡ ка́мене себѐ впꙋсти́вши, засыпа́ти поча́лъ. А҆́ле наласка́вшій Бг҃ъ, недопꙋска́ючїй, а҆бы нивто́мъ вѣ́рныи є҆гѡ̀ слꙋ́ги засрꙋ́чены не былѝ, гды́ ю́жъ в небеспе́ченствѣ бы́лъ Мѡѷсе́й, звы́клымъ є҆гѡ̀ ми́рдемъ таки́мъ спо́собомъ ᲂу҆пережа́етъ. Вели́кїй тотъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шъ Їѡа́ннъ гды̀ в Ке́лїицке свое́и пребыва́лъ, собѣ̀ само́мꙋ и҆ Бг҃ꙋ, та́къ звы́клъ бы́лъ, внима́ючи, в со́нъ нѣ́якїй впа́лъ ба́рзо то́нкїй и҆ ви́дѣлъ пре видѣ́нїе мꙋ́жа є҆дногѡ̀, кото́рый пова́жною тва́рїю и҆ поста́вою є҆гѡ̀ сꙋ́дитъ, и҆ спѧща̀ є҆мꙋ̀ вымо- вля́етъ и҆ мо́витъ: Ты́ ли Їѡа́нне та́къ безпе́чне спи́шъ, и҆
units.english_cohort_translation: ...by prayers and other utterances at last, such as are wont to come from those pierced by swords and those whose eyes are gouged out, reaching even unto heaven. Sleep he took only so much as he deemed sufficient to preserve the life of soul and mind, lest through excessive sleeplessness it should fail. And before sleep, he occupied himself as much as possible with prayers. He was also accustomed to copy small books, by which very work he drove away from himself the weakness of sloth. Unto this his whole life was directed: unceasing prayer, and incomparable love toward God; for looking upon Him day and night as in the most translucent mirror of purity, he would receive no satiety, nor indeed could he do otherwise. At a certain time [margin: Concerning the miracle of the holy man's disciple], one of those who had chosen the solitary life, Moses by name,[^1698] desiring to imitate the life of this divine Father, to be nourished by his teachings, and to learn from him the elements of true philosophy, brought forward many holy Fathers as intercessors, through whom he asked with great supplications that he would accept him as a disciple. Therefore, helped by their prayers, he was accepted by the holy man as he had desired. To him at a certain time the holy Father commanded that he should bring from a certain place soil of loamy earth, for the better cultivation of the garden and herbs. Going therefore to the place appointed for him, Moses diligently performed what had been commanded him. But when the midday hour drew near, and by the burning of the sun that place was like fire in the manner of a furnace (for it was indeed the month of August),[^1699] Moses, being exhausted and worn out from carrying the earth, considered that he needed a little rest; and letting himself rest under the shadow of a very great rock, he began to fall asleep. But the most merciful God, Who does not allow His faithful servants to be grieved in anything, when Moses was already in peril, anticipated it with His customary mercy in this manner: While that great father of ours John was in his little cell, giving heed, as was his custom, to himself and to God, he fell into a very light sleep and saw through a vision a certain man of venerable countenance and stature, who judged him and rebuked him as he slept, saying: "Dost thou sleep so carelessly, O John, while Moses is at the very brink of danger?"

units.slavonic_incipit: Бы́лъ те́жъ мꙋ́жъ ст҃ы́й, та́емныхъ ра́нъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: был теж муж стый таемных ран лекарем монах
units.slavonic_diplomatic: пѣ́снь спѣва́ючи, подѧкова́нѧ найѡквитшїи прине́съ Бг҃ꙋ. Бы́лъ те́жъ мꙋ́жъ ст҃ы́й, та́емныхъ ра́нъ лѣ́каремъ. Мона́хъ бовѣ́мъ є҆де́нъ, І҆саа́къ и҆́менемъ: гды̀ є҆дного́ ча́сꙋ тѧ́жкимъ тѣ́ла горѣ́лъ запале́ньемъ, бѣ́гомъ до не́гѡ пришо́лъ, зо всѣ́хъ сторо́нъ смꙋ́ткомъ ѡ҆бложо́ный, и҆ внꙋ́треннюю во́йнꙋ лыка́ньемъ и҆ слеза́ми ѡ҆кры́лъ. Тогѡ̀ те́ды вѣ́рѣ и҆ поко́рѣ мꙋ́жъ ст҃ы́й задивова́вшисѧ, ла́годне ты́ми слова́ми тѣ́шитъ, мо́вѧчи:
units.english_cohort_translation: Quickly therefore awakening [margin: * Moses is preserved from the greatest danger], he straightway armed himself with prayer, praying for his disciple. Whom, when he returned toward evening, he asked whether any adverse and unexpected thing had befallen him. Then he said: "A stone of marvelous size was within a little of crushing me and completely breaking me in pieces, while I was sleeping deeply beneath it, had I not, thinking that I heard thy voice, leapt out from the place with a swift bound, full of fear; and no sooner had I done so than I beheld that stone torn away from the rock and fallen to the earth!" Hearing this, the man of God, being truly humble in mind, telling his disciple nothing of what he had seen and heard, with secret cries and the voices of innermost love, singing a hymn, offered most abundant thanksgiving unto God.

units.slavonic_incipit: Ста́ймѡ, мо́витъ, ѡ҆ба́два на мл҃твꙋ сн҃ꙋ,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: стаймо мовит обадва на млтву сну и вшеляко
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ста́ймѡ, мо́витъ, ѡ҆ба́два на мл҃твꙋ сн҃ꙋ, и҆ вшеля́кѡ ла́скавый и҆ млⷭ҇рдный Гдⷭ҇ь, мл҃твы не преба́читъ на́шои. Што гды́сѧ ста́ло, и҆ є҆щѐ мл҃твы не скончи́ли, є҆ще́ ни́цъ на тва́ри недꙋ́жный бра́т лежа́лъ, во́лю слꙋгѝ своєгѡ̀ Гдⷭ҇ь ᲂу҆чини́лъ, жебы́ ѡ҆то́ль показа́лъ и҆́жъ Пррⷦ҇къ є҆гѡ̀ пра́вдꙋ мо́витъ: [margin: И҆са́: ѯ҃є.] И҆ ᲂу҆́жъ тѣ́ла ѡ҆бѣ́гъ, сꙋ́тѧми приле́жнои мл҃твы ᲂу҆скромле́ный. Поты́мъ то́тъ, кото́рый пре́ ты́мъ бы́лъ хо́рый, вызболе́ного себѐ ѿ хоро́бы ви́дѧчи, и҆ ѿ вшеля́когѡ ю́жъ тако́вого замѣ́шаньѧ ᲂу҆лѣгчо́ного, здꙋмѣ́лъ сѧ ба́рзо, и҆ Бг҃ꙋ и҆ знамени́томꙋ є҆гѡ̀ слꙋ́зѣ пода́ковлє ᲂу҆чини́лъ.
units.english_cohort_translation: This holy man was also a physician of secret wounds. For a certain monk, Isaac by name, burning at a certain time with a grievous inflammation of the flesh, came running unto him, encompassed with sorrow on all sides, and disclosed his inward warfare with sobbing and tears. At whose faith and humility the holy man, being struck with wonder, gently comforted him with these words, saying: "Let us both stand for prayer, my son, and the all-gracious and merciful Lord will not overlook our prayer." And when this was done, and they had not yet finished praying, while the afflicted brother was still lying prone on his face, the Lord fulfilled the will of His servant, that He might show thence that His Prophet speaks the truth: *And before they call, I will hear them; while they are yet speaking, I will say: What is it?* (Isa. 65:24),[^1700] and the burning of the flesh was immediately subdued by the fervency of diligent prayer. Afterwards, he who had formerly been sick, seeing himself healed of his illness and relieved from all such turmoil, was exceedingly astonished, and gave thanksgiving unto God and unto His renowned servant.

units.slavonic_incipit: роспа́ленни, и҆ та́къ вели́кїй пожи́токъ, кото́рый
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: роспаленни и так великий пожиток который з его
units.slavonic_diplomatic: роспа́ленни, и҆ та́къ вели́кїй пожи́токъ, кото́рый з є҆гѡ̀ наᲂу҆́ки сѧ роди́лъ, загамова́ти ᲂу҆си́лꙋючи, велемо́вцею є҆гѡ̀ и҆ лгаре́мъ зва́ти поча́ли. Што ѻ҆́нъ ви́дѧчи, и҆ навꙋчи́вшысѧ и҆́жъ всѐ в то́мъ, кото́рїй є҆гѡ̀ покрѣплѧ́лъ Хѐ мо́жетъ, [margin: в҃ Ко́: в҃і.] и҆ не то́лкѡ прѐ сло́вное напомина́нье, ты которы́и до не́го дла пожи́ткꙋ своєгѡ приходи́ли, навꙋча́ти хотя́чи, а҆́ле дале́ко ба́рзѣй прѐ молча́нье, и҆ през ᲂу҆чи́нковꙋю Фїлосо́фїю, жебы́, ꙗ҆́къ є҆́стъ напи́сано, ѡ҆тѧ́лъ
units.english_cohort_translation: When, moreover, this venerable Father bountifully nourished with the word of grace those who came unto him, and poured forth streams of instruction most abundantly, certain malicious men, inflamed with the torches of envy [margin: From detractors he endures the withholding of speech], striving to stop so great a benefit as was born from his teaching, began to call him a chatterer and a liar. Seeing this, and having learned that he could do all things in Christ Who strengthened him (Phil. 4:13; cf. 2 Cor. 12:9),[^1701] and desiring to instruct those who came to him for their own profit not only by spoken admonition, but far more by silence and practical philosophy, so that, as it is written, he might cut off...

units.slavonic_incipit: шꙋка́ючихъ ѡ҆ка́зїи, а́жъ до пе́вногѡ ча́сꙋ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: шукаючих оказии аж до певного часу молчати постановил
units.slavonic_diplomatic: шꙋка́ючихъ ѡ҆ка́зїи, а́жъ до пе́вногѡ ча́сꙋ молча́ти постанови́лъ, и҆ медоточи́вꙋ наᲂу҆́ки рѣкꙋ̀ загамова́ти: розꙋмѣ́ючи и҆́жъ ра́днѣй и҆ лѣ́пнѣй є҆́стъ, же́бы того́ ты́мъ ча́сомъ шко́дою наба́влени былѝ пи́льныи до́брыхъ ре́чїй ми́лосники, кото́рымъ сна́ть пре молча́е ба́рзѣй пожи́точнымъ мѣ́лъ бы́ти, а҆ниже́ли невдя́чныи ѻ҆́ныи сꙋ́дове ба́рзѣй раздражне́нни зоста́ли, а҆́бы дале́й и҆́хъ зло́сть и҆ злосли́ваѧ во́лѧ не выроста́ла. Пре́тожъ и҆ ѻ҆нѝ збоя́вшисѧ поко́ры и҆ скро́мности мꙋ́жа, и҆ ᲂу҆зна́вшисѧ, же тако́гѡ собѣ̀ пожи́ткꙋ жро́дло затамова́ли, и҆ та́къ великои шко́ды всѣ́мъ причи́ною зоста́ли, до мꙋ́жа з поко́рою и҆ про́збою прихо́дятъ, и҆ ѡ҆ сло́во наᲂу҆́ки посполи́тымъ шля́хомъ з и҆́ными про́сѧтъ.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...an occasion from those who sought an occasion (2 Cor. 11:12), he resolved to keep silence for a certain time, and to dam up the honey-flowing river of his teaching; deeming that it was better and more profitable that the diligent lovers of good things should for that time suffer harm—unto whom, indeed, he was to be more profitable through silence—than that those ungrateful vessels should be further irritated, lest their malice and wicked will should grow any further. Therefore they also, being struck with fear at the humility and modesty of the man, and having recognized that they had dammed up for themselves the fountain of such benefit and had become the cause of so great harm unto all, came unto the man with humility and supplication, and asked for the word of teaching in the common way together with the others. He therefore straightway consented, as one who did not know how to oppose anyone, and took up again the occupation of his former estate.

units.english_text: ...an occasion from those who sought an occasion (2 Cor. 11:12), he resolved to keep silence for a certain time, and to dam up the honey-flowing river of his teaching; deeming that it was better and more profitable that the diligent lovers of good things should for that time suffer harm—unto whom, indeed, he was to be more profitable through silence—than that those ungrateful vessels should be further irritated, lest their malice and wicked will should grow any further. Therefore they also, being struck with fear at the humility and modesty of the man, and having recognized that they had dammed up for themselves the fountain of such benefit and had become the cause of so great harm unto all, came unto the man with humility and supplication, and asked for the word of teaching in the common way together with the others. He therefore straightway consented, as one who did not know how to oppose anyone, and took up again the occupation of his former estate.

units.slavonic_incipit: Та́къ те́ды вы́полнилъ коне́цъ ви́домомгѡ живота̀
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: так теды выполнил конец видомомго живота на на
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Та́къ те́ды вы́полнилъ коне́цъ ви́домомгѡ живота̀ на На- ча́лствѣ И҆́ньцта́нъ Мона́хѡвъ, в то́мъ ти́лко ѿ Мѡѷсе́а ро́знымъ бꙋ́дꙋчи, же на вы́шнїй І҆ерл҃имъ з вели́кою ла́твостїю встꙋ́пилъ. Ѻ҆́нъ бовѣ́мъ, невѣ́мъ ꙗ҆ки́мъ спо́собомъ, и҆ земны́ѧ ре́чи низа́што положи́лъ. А҆ свѣ́дками сꙋ́тъ ты̑мъ ре́чемъ што є҆смо̀ мо́вили, и҆́ле и҆́хъ пре́ не́го, Дх҃а ст҃гѡ вымо́вами и҆ ла́скою ѡ҆бда́рени зоста́ли, а҆ з ты́хъ ба́рзо и҆́хъ мно́гѡ которы́и ла́скою є҆гѡ̀ зба́вени сꙋ́тъ и҆ ны́нѣ сп҃са́ютсѧ. Свѣ́докъ най- лѣ́пшїй прм҃рогѡ сегѡ̀ зба́венѧ поспо́лꙋ и҆ про́сти новыи Дв҃дъ.
units.english_cohort_translation: When therefore he was so renowned in all good things that none like him could be found, with one common voice [margin: How he was chosen for leadership/instruction] and one will, like a new Moses, they took him, even against his will, unto the instruction and governance of the brethren; elevating him as a light upon the candlestick of leadership (Matt. 5:15), being themselves the best judges of such things; nor were they deceived in their hope. For he also ascended the mountain, and entering into the consecrated darkness, received the Law written by the hands of God; and enjoying the contemplation of God, and ascending by spiritual steps, with the word of God he opened his mouth, and drawing in the Spirit, poured forth a good word from the good treasure of his heart (Ps. 44:2 LXX; Matt. 12:35).[^1702]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣ́докъ є҆щѐ и҆ Па́стырь нашъ найлѣ́пшїй Їѡа́ннъ, ѿ кото́рого вели́кїй ѻ҆́ный ᲂу҆прошо́ный з горы́ Сїна́йскои а́жъ до на́съ вѣ́- домити дш҃евною з стꙋпꙋ́ючи, ꙗ҆́кобы но́вый нѣ́якїй Бг҃ови́децъ, своѝ ѿ Бг҃а табли́цѣ напи́саныи Лѣ́ствицꙋ мо́влю, ᲂу҆каза́лъ на́мъ: З надво́рѧ в пра́вдѣ працови́тогѡ живота̀,
units.english_cohort_translation: Thus, then, he completed the end of his visible life in the leadership of the monastic community, differing from Moses only in this: that he entered into the heavenly Jerusalem with great ease; for he, I know not how, accounted earthly things as nothing. And witnesses unto these things which we have said are all those who through him were endowed with the eloquence and grace of the Holy Spirit; and of these, very many are they who by his grace were saved and are saved now. A best witness of this wise salvation, both simple and righteous, is a new David.[^1703] A witness also is our best shepherd John,[^1704] by whom that great man, being entreated, descending from Mount Sinai unto us with spiritual knowledge, even as some new Seer of God, showed unto us his God-written tablets—I mean the *Ladder*—instructing us from without, indeed, in the laborious life...

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: оум мой плениша помышлениа непостоянная и уязивше страстми

units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Unstable thoughts have captured my mind, and having wounded me with passions, have left me dead through the multitude of transgressions; but do Thou heal me, O Savior!

units.slavonic_diplomatic: На па́жити вы́шнѧгѡ црⷭ҇твїа, ста́до Ѻ҆́ч҃е воспи- та́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ жезло́мъ догма́тъ, ѕвѣ́ри ѡ҆гна́лъ є҆сѝ є҆ресе́й, и҆ воспѣ́лъ є҆сѝ: ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ Бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ :~

units.slavonic_incipit: Хв҃а, ѡ҆де́жею ѡ҆болче́нъ досто́йною зва́вшагѡ, в
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: хва одежею оболчен достойною звавшаго в нем же

units.slavonic_incipit: Не послꙋжи́ша тва́ри: Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рмо́съ.
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: не послужиша твари песн и ирмос тебе вседетелю
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Катава́сїа: Не послꙋжи́ша тва́ри: Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рмо́съ. Тебѣ̀ вседѣ́телю: Ѿ разбо́йникъ по́мыслѡвъ мои́хъ Сп҃се, растлѣ́хъ житїѐ моѐ, согрѣше́нїй ꙗ҆́звами, тѣ́мже Бж҃твеннагѡ ѡ҆бнажи́хъсѧ ѡ҆́браза, тебѐ чл҃колюби́вагѡ Бг҃а. но ᲂу҆ще́дри мѧ̀:
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* By the thieves of my thoughts, O Savior, have I corrupted my life with the wounds of sins; therefore have I been stripped naked of the divine image, O Thou Lover of mankind and God; but take compassion on me!

units.english_text: *Troparion:* By the thieves of my thoughts, O Savior, have I corrupted my life with the wounds of sins; therefore have I been stripped naked of the divine image, O Thou Lover of mankind and God; but take compassion on me!

units.slavonic_incipit: Прише́лъ є҆сѝ на́ земли ѿ вы́шнихъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: пришел еси на земли от вышних спсе ущедрив
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Прише́лъ є҆сѝ на́ земли ѿ вы́шнихъ Сп҃се, ᲂу҆ще́дривъ ꙗ҆́звами ᲂу҆ране́ннаго мѧ̀, всего согрѣше́нїй ще́дре, и҆ и҆злїѧ́въ на мѧ̀ Хѐ млⷭ҇ть твою̀:
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou hast come upon earth from the heights, O Savior, taking compassion on me who am wounded with wounds, all-covered with transgressions, O Compassionate One, and pouring out Thy mercy upon me, O Christ!

units.slavonic_incipit: Тѣ́ло и҆ дш҃ꙋ ты̀ Влⷣко Сп҃се,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тело и дшу ты влко спсе избаву дал
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Тѣ́ло и҆ дш҃ꙋ ты̀ Влⷣко Сп҃се, и҆зба́вꙋ да́лъ є҆сѝ за мѧ̀, и҆ сп҃слъ мѧ̀ є҆сѝ мече́мъ грѣхо́въ ᲂу҆ѧ́звленнаго, в неисцѣ́льныхъ ꙗ҆́звахъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇тивый:
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Body and soul, O Master and Savior, hast Thou given as a ransom for me, and Thou hast saved me who was pierced by the sword of sins in incurable wounds, as Thou art merciful!
units.slavonic_text: Тѣ́ло и҆ дш҃ꙋ ты̀ Влⷣко Сп҃се, и҆зба́вꙋ да́лъ є҆сѝ за мѧ̀, и҆ сп҃слъ мѧ̀ є҆сѝ мече́мъ грѣхо́въ ᲂу҆ѧ́звленнаго, в неисцѣ́льныхъ ꙗ҆́звахъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇тивый:
